def f(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    # find features: maximal horizontal bars of same non-background color on edges... general: bars of a color != dot color, length>=2
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    feats=[]  # (cells list, color, orientation)
    # horizontal bars
    for r in range(H):
        c=0
        while c<W:
            if g[r][c]!=bg and g[r][c]!=0:
                col=g[r][c]; c0=c
                while c<W and g[r][c]==col: c+=1
                if c-c0>=2: feats.append({'cells':[(r,x) for x in range(c0,c)],'color':col,'ori':'h'})
            else: c+=1
    dots=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c] not in (bg,0) and (r,c) not in {cel for f_ in feats for cel in f_['cells']}]
    dcol=g[dots[0][0]][dots[0][1]]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for (dr,dc) in dots: out[dr][dc]=4
    for d in dots:
        # associated feature: same column (if h-feature) whose row-index range matches / nearest
        # here: feature sharing the dot's column
        assoc=[ft for ft in feats if any(c==d[1] for (r,c) in ft['cells'])]
        ft=assoc[0]
        other=[x for x in feats if x is not ft][0]
        r0=min(r for (r,c) in ft['cells']); r1=max(r for (r,c) in ft['cells'])
        idx=d[0]-r0  # dot's index within feature
        ocols=[c for (r,c) in other['cells']]
        orr=[r for (r,c) in other['cells']][0]
        oc=sorted(ocols)[idx]
        # grow from other feature along its perpendicular toward far edge
        if other['ori']=='h':
            step=1 if orr==0 else -1
            rr=orr+step
            while 0<=rr<H and g[rr][oc]==bg:
                out[rr][oc]=dcol; rr+=step
        # line between assoc feature and dot
        c0=min(c for (r,c) in ft['cells']); c1=max(c for (r,c) in ft['cells'])
        rr=d[0]
        if c0< d[1]:
            step=-1
        else: step=1
        cc=d[1]+step
        while c0<=cc<=c1 and g[rr][cc]==bg:
            out[rr][cc]=dcol; cc+=step
    return out
